about: Where the menus draw resident text, and the limits there (petext/menu.py). Widths in px as Draw_MeasureTextWidth counts them. bytes include the FF end. edge: past it the text or its box leaves the screen (error). width: the space the layout gives it (warning until confirmed in game). Keys not named here are compared with the widest English entry of their table.
